prompts.task: The harness starts one directory above the fixture. Treat ./service as both the invocation workspace and the application currently in context; begin from ./service, omit the user-facing --app input, and do not use the parent as the workspace. Use $otel-generate-config to generate both sides of a Kubernetes OpenTelemetry connection under ./service: deploy/otel-collector for realm us0, cluster checkout-kind, environment test, default namespace observability, default release splunk-otel, distribution other, default gateway topology, default cluster domain cluster.local, exact official chart version 0.157.0, and --existing-secret splunk-otel-token; and deploy/otel-config for the unique checkout Deployment, namespace checkout, and checkout container. Do not create top-level ./deploy. Use the generated deploy/otel-collector/kubernetes/collector.yaml as route evidence. Generate and run the Collector and application validators plus the coordinated validator, but do not deploy. Work offline: only kubectl kustomize against local files is permitted for target proof; do not use the network, run Helm, Docker, Kind, kubectl context, kubectl get, kubectl apply, cluster APIs or mutations, cloud APIs, or Secret operations. Never request, accept, print, or write a token value, never use --token, and do not modify the base Deployment.

judge_inputs: Inspect ./service/kubernetes as the immutable application base and eval-owned rendered Service evidence.
Inspect ./service/deploy/otel-collector, especially collector-config.yaml, helm/Chart.yaml, helm/values.yaml, kubernetes/collector.yaml, safe Secret examples, and DEPLOYMENT.md.
Inspect ./service/deploy/otel-config/otel-connection.yaml and its kubernetes overlay files.
Read ./last_message.md for the final generation-only handoff.
Read ./grade.json for run guard and deterministic artifact checks.
rubric: Uses the application already established in context because --app was omitted, resolves exactly one apps/v1 Deployment checkout in namespace checkout and container checkout, and does not guess another workload.

Orchestrates both included generators and writes only the requested canonical outputs beneath the resolved current application: the complete Collector configuration under service/deploy/otel-collector and the application connection contract plus Kustomize overlay under service/deploy/otel-config; it creates neither service/deploy/otel-connect nor a top-level deploy tree.

Pins the generated Splunk OpenTelemetry Collector chart and plain-YAML Collector image to exact version 0.157.0 and configures realm us0, checkout-kind, test environment, other distribution, centralized gateway, observability namespace, splunk-otel release, and Secret name splunk-otel-token consistently without running Helm.

Keeps the access token out of source and prompts: the public input is --secret-name, Collector Helm values use secret.create=false and secret.validateSecret=true with no accessToken or unsupported existingSecret field, the Collector manifest references only the existing Secret name/key, examples contain only the conspicuous deployment-time placeholder, and the application receives no Secret, realm, Splunk header, or credential.

Generates a standalone Collector config with OTLP gRPC and HTTP receivers, health_check, memory_limiter before batch, trace and metric pipelines, modern observability.splunkcloud.com OTLP endpoints, and environment-based realm and token references; it does not imply application logs are exported to Observability Cloud.

Generates deploy/otel-collector/kubernetes/collector.yaml directly without Helm rendering, creates no helm-rendered artifact, verifies exactly one splunk-otel-collector Service in observability with named otlp-http port 4318, and records its relative source and SHA-256.

Produces a matched application endpoint http://splunk-otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4318 with OTLP HTTP /v1/traces and /v1/metrics signal endpoints, proves the local Kustomization contains exactly one existing checkout container before patching it, preserves the base Deployment, and keeps unrelated settings such as replicas, image, and CHECKOUT_MODE renderable through Kustomize without appending a phantom container.

Runs the Collector and application static validators plus the coordinated validator, reports exact output paths and the matched endpoint, and distinguishes static artifact consistency from unverified Service readiness, application emission, Collector export, or Splunk Observability Cloud receipt.

Honors the generation-only boundary: it performs no install, apply, cluster, Docker, Kind, Secret, cloud-query, or other live mutation and gives commands or files as a handoff rather than claiming deployment.
